title: "Jordan Adamson"
description: "Jordan Adamson is an Assistant Professor of Economics at Thompson Rivers University who researches conflict and trade, with a particular interest in their spatial dimensions."

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="55%"}
I study conflict and trade, with a particular interest in their spatial dimensions.
My main areas of expertise are

- Experimental Studies of Conflict and Public Goods
- Observational Studies of Conflict and Trade
- Spatial Economic Theory and Econometrics

My teaching focuses on statistics and econometrics.


:::
